changeSet.sql: UPDATE customer SET created_at = COALESCE(created_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), created_by = COALESCE(created_by, 'system') WHERE created_at IS NULL OR created_by IS NULL; UPDATE accounts SET created_at = COALESCE(created_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), created_by = COALESCE(created_by, 'system') WHERE created_at IS NULL OR created_by IS NULL;

changeSet.sql: SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('customer', 'customer_id'), GREATEST(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(customer_id) FROM customer), 0) + 1, nextval(pg_get_serial_sequence('customer', 'customer_id'))), false);
